purpose: Part 3/3 of verified final 30-record item effect batch 031; together these files contain exactly 30 reviewed records from the 30-record checkpoint.

items/ring-elemental-command-water-71.name: Ring of Elemental Command (water)
items/ring-elemental-command-water-71.effectSummary: As a fully activated elemental-command ring, elementals of its attuned plane cannot attack the wearer or approach within 5 feet unless the wearer gives up that protection to attempt charm monster (Will DC 17); a failed charm permanently forfeits the absolute protection and prevents further charm attempts. Attuned-planar creatures attacking the wearer take -1 on attacks; the wearer gets +2 resistance on saves against their attacks, +4 morale on attacks against them, weapons wielded bypass their DR, and the wearer can converse with them. The water ring also imposes -2 on the wearer's saves against fire-based effects. Its full powers are water walk at will, create water at will, water breathing at will, wall of ice 1/day, ice storm 2/week, and control water 2/week. Before its special activation condition is met it appears to be only a ring of water walking.

provenance.role: 3.5 SRD elemental-command common rules and water power list cross-check

items/robe-of-the-mad-archmage.name: Robe of the Mad Archmage
items/robe-of-the-mad-archmage.effectSummary: This chaotic-neutral intelligent robe functions as a robe of blending, grants +2 on caster-level checks to overcome spell resistance, and grants a +5 insight bonus to AC and all saving throws. Three times per day, the wearer can cast a spell of up to 9th level as though Quickened without increasing spell level or casting time; a spell already prepared with or affected by a metamagic feat cannot use this ability. The robe can also store up to 10 spell levels as a ring of spell storing. Intelligence 18, Wisdom 10, Charisma 18; speech in Abyssal, Ancient Suloise, Celestial, Common, Draconic, and Flan; telepathy; darkvision/hearing 120 ft.; blindsense 120 ft. A personality conflict occurs whenever the wearer tries to remove it to don another magical garment. Its dominant emotion is curious longing for magical treasure or arcane lore.

provenance.role: Dragon #359 compilation cross-check for the source-clipped +5 insight bonus

items/saddle-of-speed-790.name: Saddle of Speed
items/saddle-of-speed-790.effectSummary: The saddle duplicates repeated applications of the Speed of Thought feat; each saddle level represents one such increment and the actual speed increase is limited by both the saddle's level and the wearer's current psionic reserve. For a wearer with a psionic class, use the feat normally. For a wearer with psionic powers but no psionic class, maximum supported level is based on reserve/highest-level power: 3 reserve PP or 1st-2nd-level power -> level 1 (+10 ft.); 5-7 PP or 3rd-4th -> level 2 (+20 ft.); 9-11 PP or 5th-6th -> level 3 (+30 ft.); 13-15 PP or 7th-8th -> level 4 (+40 ft.); 17 PP or 9th -> level 5 (+50 ft.). In all cases use the lower of the saddle's capability and the wearer's reserve. Saddle levels 1-5 have ML 3/6/9/12/15 and prices 2,000/8,500/18,000/32,000/50,000 gp respectively.

items/sphere-annihilation-133.name: Sphere of Annihilation
items/sphere-annihilation-133.effectSummary: This 2-foot-diameter sphere destroys any matter it touches; only direct deity intervention can restore a creature annihilated by it. It is normally stationary. Controlling it is a move-action DC 30 check of 1d20 + character level + Intelligence modifier. On success, it can be moved as a free action; initial control range is 40 feet, and once controlled the range is 40 feet + 10 feet/character level. Its speed is 10 feet + 5 feet for each 5 points by which that round's control check exceeds 30. Control checks are required each round; on a failed check the sphere slides 10 feet toward the controller. Competing controllers make opposed checks; if none succeed it moves toward the lowest roller. A gate cast on it has d% results: 01-50 destroys the sphere, 51-85 does nothing, 86-100 tears open space and sends everything within 180 feet to another plane. A rod of cancellation touching it destroys both in an explosion dealing 2d6x10 damage within 60 feet. Dispel magic and mage's disjunction have no effect. A talisman of the sphere modifies its control rules as described by that artifact.

provenance.role: 3.5 SRD control, collision, gate, and rod-of-cancellation interaction cross-check

items/staffofancientpenumbra-645.name: Staff of Ancient Penumbra
items/staffofancientpenumbra-645.effectSummary: This intelligent lawful-evil +5 quarterstaff (Int 16, Wis 14, Cha 18, Ego 18) has the special purpose of advancing illithid rulership and works at manifester level 25. A new creature touching it must succeed Diplomacy DC 18; failure makes the staff lash the petitioner with a 5d6 fire energy bolt each round and set them on fire. Beginning after the first round, Fort DC 20 each round ends the fire; control flames or similar powers grant +4 on that save. A survivor may try Diplomacy again, but the DC rises by 2 per prior failure. If accepted, the staff telepathically explains its powers; a wielder resisting its special purpose must win DC 18 Will checks during personality conflicts. If dominant, it may blast the wielder or allies within 15 feet with 5d6 fire until placated by a promise to take it to the nearest mind flayer. In combat it is a +5 quarterstaff; on a critical hit it also deals the 5d6 fire bolt, and the wielder can fire that bolt at a target within 15 feet as a standard action, setting a hit target on fire. Three times/day after failing a save against a spell or power, the wielder can immediately reroll that save. Up to five times/day the staff manifests body adjustment on the wielder without an action, and can similarly heal an undead wielder using negative energy. The wielder can always see 30 feet through darkness, fog, smoke, and similar obscuration; as a standard action can see through up to 6 inches of solid material for 3 rounds; and can manifest true seeing 1/day if the staff judges it useful to its purpose. It is destroyed only by throwing it into the star at Penumbra's hub.

items/staff-rapture-426.name: Staff of Rapture
items/staff-rapture-426.effectSummary: In a cleric's hands this ash staff shines like a torch. It functions as a +1 quarterstaff that deals only nonlethal damage and has a 17-20 critical threat range against evil creatures. Its spells are atonement (2 charges), divination (1), elation (1), sword of conscience (2), and vision of heaven (1).

items/staff-woodlands-327.name: Staff of the Woodlands
items/staff-woodlands-327.effectSummary: The staff can cast charm animal (1 charge), speak with animals (1), barkskin (2), wall of thorns (3), summon nature's ally VI (3), and animate plants (4). It also functions as a +2 quarterstaff and grants pass without trace at will with no charge cost. The +2 weapon function and pass-without-trace ability continue even after all staff charges are expended.

provenance.role: 3.5 SRD staff spell list, charge costs, and no-charge weapon/pass-without-trace powers

items/sunstaff-427.name: Sunstaff
items/sunstaff-427.effectSummary: As a free action, the staff transforms into a +3 brilliant energy quarterstaff; returning it to staff form is also a free action and enables its spell powers. Its spells are bless (1 charge), crown of flame (2), searing light (1), and shield other (1).

items/the-diamond-warrior-mask-734.name: The Diamond Warrior Mask
items/the-diamond-warrior-mask-734.effectSummary: Diamond warriors use several crystal-mask variants. Crystal Mask of Deception grants conceal thoughts while worn (ML 5; 1,500 gp). Crystal Mask of Doubt forces each creature entering melee with the wearer to make Will DC 14 once per combat or take a -1 morale penalty from the shifting visage (ML 5; 1,500 gp). Crystal Mask of Darkvision grants the darkvision psionic power while worn (ML 6; 8,000 gp). Crystal Mask of Shifting can manifest plane shift 1/day, carrying the wearer and up to seven other creatures who join hands (ML 14; 40,000 gp). Diamond warriors receive mask choices at class levels 1, 5, and 9 as described by the class.

items/regalia-good-462.name: The Regalia of Good
items/regalia-good-462.effectSummary: The Regalia of Good comprises Crown, Scepter, and Orb. Crown: for a good wearer, immunity to electricity, +4 enhancement Wisdom, +4 deflection AC, SR 20, guidance at will, heroes' feast/sending/greater status 3/day each, globe of invulnerability 1/day, all at CL 20; wearer cannot lie. Scepter: while possessed by a good character, +4 enhancement Charisma and immunity to mind-affecting effects; command obedience as rod of rulership with no use limit; holy smite (DC 19) and searing light (DC 18) 3/day each at CL 20; wielder becomes increasingly unable to refuse pleas for help. Orb: good wielder turns/destroys undead as a 15th-level cleric, gains +4 enhancement Intelligence, can scry as crystal ball with detect thoughts, and can cast heal by touch 1/day as a 20th-level cleric. Resonance with any two pieces grants Spell Focus (Good), Gift of Faith, Nimbus of Light, and Words of Creation, +1 circumstance on saves vs electricity, petrification, cold, acid, fire, and poison, low-light vision, darkvision 60 ft., and halves the normal price in goods/services paid to a celestial called with lesser/normal/greater planar ally. Possessing all three also grants +4 enhancement Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution; any wielded weapon becomes holy (+2d6 vs evil); and allies within 30 ft. gain +4 morale on saves vs fear. A nongood character attempting to use a piece takes 5d6 damage; an evil character must also make Will DC 18 or lose 2,000 XP.
